blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — The three-day search for a missing bamboo gatherer ended in grief on Wednesday morning after his decomposing body was found downstream along the Manupali River. The victim, 38-year-old Rocky Bitos of Barangay Colonia, went missing on Sunday, October 18, after drowning while navigating a handmade bamboo raft (gakit) along the river boundary separating Lantapan town and Valencia City. A resident grazing his cattle in Sitio Lanrico, Barangay Kulasihan, Lantapan, noticed a foul odor near the riverbank and spotted Bitos’ bloated body.
